notes.title: New price & new languages!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41174152/57088dba04a6c72e013343b957ce77638eca1dbd.png[/img]
Greetings, Earthlings!
Meet the galactic update for Looking for Aliens.

List of changes:
• Added French localization.
• Added Dutch localization.
• Added Korean localization.

We are also pleased to announce that the price for Looking for Aliens has been reduced!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733500/Looking_for_Aliens/

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
A new update for Looking for Aliens is now available 👽

List of changes:
- Added VSync option at the request of players
- Added ability to move using WASD keys 
- Other minor fixes

This update will be available for both full and demo versions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41174152/251b260dfb45d5a9a00146bcab2dc7972aaf16f6.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733500

notes.title: Update: Looking for Aliens Demo
notes.content:
The demo now contains even more human speech options!

Full list of languages available in the demo:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Portuguese - Brazil
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41174152/37902aa00c05fceace0572ac6c9e378e3e02cbe9.gif[/img]

In the meantime, add the game to your Wishlist and download the demo so people won't know you're one of us! 👽
